metadata.method: isolated source; hidden behavioral acceptance; rotated arm order; shuffled tasks; host-model settings explicit; task time includes supplied briefing and agent calls, excludes install and acceptance; no population benefit claim

post_processing.method: All rows recalculated from raw report envelopes, handling global flags before the command; recorded metrics retained. Calls bypassing the instrumented binary are not inferred.

paired_against_without.uncertainty_limit: Fixed synthetic tasks are not a representative random sample; a null interval means the observed task differences supply no empirical variance estimate.

limits: Purpose-built small repositories; not independently reported edits.
